title: Communauté
description: Membres, activité, candidatures et flottes déclarées.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM core.users WHERE active

panels.title: Vus sur 7 jours
panels.description: Comptes actifs avec une activité enregistrée (connexion ou action) dans les 7 derniers jours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM core.users WHERE active AND last_seen_at >= localtimestamp - interval '7 days'
SELECT count(*) FROM core.users WHERE active AND last_seen_at >= localtimestamp - interval '30 days'
SELECT count(*) FROM core.users WHERE active AND (last_seen_at IS NULL OR last_seen_at < localtimestamp - interval '30 days')
SELECT count(*) FROM core.users WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Notifications push activées
panels.description: Membres ayant au moins un appareil abonné aux notifications.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM core.notification_subscriptions

SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS "Inscriptions"
        FROM core.users WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Membres inscrits (cumul)
panels.description: Comptes créés à chaque date, désactivés compris : la base ne date pas les désactivations.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, (SELECT count(*) FROM core.users u WHERE u.created_at < day + interval '1 day') AS "Membres"
        FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp), localtimestamp, interval '1 day') AS day
        ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.name AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM core.user_roles ur
        JOIN core.roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN core.users u ON u.id = ur.user_id
        WHERE u.active GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT CASE status WHEN 'CONNECTE' THEN 'Connecté' WHEN 'ABSENT' THEN 'Absent'
                           WHEN 'HORS_LIGNE' THEN 'Hors ligne' ELSE status END AS metric, count(*) AS value
        FROM core.users WHERE active GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT 'Membres avec une collection' AS metric, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS value FROM collections.user_collection
        UNION ALL SELECT 'Collections', count(*) FROM collections.user_collection
SELECT count(*) FROM recruitment.recruitment WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT count(*) FROM recruitment.recruitment WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Acceptées sur la période
panels.description: Part des candidatures traitées (hors attente) qui ont été acceptées.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVED')::numeric / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'PENDING'), 0), 3)
        FROM recruitment.recruitment WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Délai depuis la plus ancienne en attente

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - min(created_at)) FROM recruitment.recruitment WHERE status = 'PENDING'

SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time,
               CASE status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'En attente' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'Acceptée'
                           WHEN 'REFUSED' THEN 'Refusée' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN 'Annulée' ELSE status END AS metric,
               count(*) AS value
        FROM recruitment.recruitment WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(nullif(btrim(preferred_gameplay), ''), 'Non précisé') AS metric, count(*) AS value
        FROM recruitment.recruitment WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM fleet.user_ships
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM fleet.user_ships
SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_game_purchase)::numeric / nullif(count(*), 0), 3) FROM fleet.user_ships
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE loaner) FROM fleet.user_ships

SELECT coalesce(s.name, 'Vaisseau n°' || us.ship_id) AS metric, count(*) AS value
        FROM fleet.user_ships us LEFT JOIN catalog.ship_compat s ON s.id = us.ship_id
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 15

SELECT coalesce(nullif(s.focus, ''), 'Rôle non renseigné') AS metric, count(*) AS value
        FROM fleet.user_ships us LEFT JOIN catalog.ship_compat s ON s.id = us.ship_id
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT count(*) FROM utils.exec_hangar_player_status WHERE has_exec_ship

panels.title: Comptes en attente d'un nouveau mot de passe
panels.description: Comptes créés ou réinitialisés par un administrateur, dont le mot de passe provisoire n'a pas été changé.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM core.users WHERE active AND pwd_reset

panels.title: Membres ayant coupé toutes les notifications

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM core.user_params p JOIN core.users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.active AND NOT p.notif_global

panels.title: Membres connectés par jour
panels.description: Membres ayant ouvert ou prolongé une session ce jour-là (jetons de session émis).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Membres connectés"
        FROM core.refresh_tokens WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Membres connectés"
        FROM core.refresh_tokens WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heures de connexion (heure de Paris)
panels.description: Pour chaque heure de la journée : nombre de fois où un membre était connecté (un membre compte une fois par jour). Utile pour choisir l'horaire des événements.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(extract(hour FROM created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::text, 2, '0') || ' h' AS metric,
               count(DISTINCT (user_id, (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date)) AS value
        FROM core.refresh_tokens WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Préférences de notification
panels.description: Membres actifs ayant laissé chaque type de notification activé.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS metric, count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_) AS value FROM core.user_params p
        JOIN core.users u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.active
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('Toutes', p.notif_global), ('Événements', p.notif_events), ('Flotte', p.notif_fleet),
                                   ('Objectifs', p.notif_goals), ('Discord', p.notif_discord)) AS v(label, on_)
        GROUP BY label ORDER BY 2 DESC
